summary:
Main
Today， DCE iron ore futures first fell and then rebounded today. The most-traded contract I2605 eventually closedat 809 yuan/mt, down 0.74% from the previous trading session. Traders were only moderately active in offering prices, while steel mills made fewer inquiries, with purchases mainly driven by rigid demand.
